target_customer: Enterprise and tech-forward teams that pay for an AI agent that operates existing software like a human
problem: Repetitive knowledge work across systems like Salesforce, HubSpot and Jira lacks APIs, so automation needs fragile integrations.
business_model: SaaS subscription for a desktop and cloud AI agent (pricing not found)

founders.name: Jonas Nelle
previous_startups: Oracle for zero-knowledge rollups on Ethereum (sold)
founders.background_notes: Born in Berlin, per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable multi-step computer use with a mouse and keyboard was unsolved in 2023 and depended on models that were not yet good at it.

defensibility.rationale: Model labs and well funded agent startups could build the same capability, and the product depended on third party models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Labs shipped computer-use agents. YC lists Autotab as acquired but no buyer is named in found sources.

market_need_then: Strong interest in AI agents in 2023, but the YC page claims on reliability are the company's own marketing and no independent usage data was found.

branding.domain_note: Holds exact autotab.com, per the YC page and site

identity.visual_style: Clean enterprise landing page with OpenAI and YC backed logos

brand_strength.rationale: Exact .com and a short name are assets, but no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Autotab built a computer-use agent for enterprise work in 2023, early for the underlying models and in the path of the major labs. YC lists it as acquired, but no buyer, date or price was found, and the website footer names an entity called Planetary Computers, Inc. Whether this was a win or a soft landing is not public.
notes: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed 2023-09 and another aggregator lists $3.15M total; both unverified and not recorded. The site shows OpenAI and YC as backers but gives no amounts. One aggregator mentions Cursor as a buyer in a single snippet; unverified and not recorded. Competitor search returned only current directory pages (MultiOn, Induced AI, Adept) with no source dated near mid 2023, so the list is empty. Branding search found nothing. Completeness pass: the 500K round rests on VCBacked (pre-seed 2023-09) and CB Insights (convertible note 2023-01, same 500K); dates conflict, one round recorded.
